content.title: Gannon Athletics  - Believe. Inspire. Transform.
content.text: skip to main content Athletics Priorities Enriching Our Student Experience Athletics Gannon is an NCAA Division II institution offering 24 scholarship-granting varsity sports. The majority of our NCAA athletic teams regularly participate in or qualify for conference and/or national postseasons. Gannon student-athletes have achieved high levels of success on and off the field. The University lands in the top five among conference schools with higher-than-average GPAs and has consistently earned PSAC Scholar-Athlete accolades. Additional scholarship funding will help Gannon attract a caliber of student-athletes best suited to the University, as well as provide operating funds for items like uniforms and travel expenses that will propel our students’ athletic experience and help them achieve confidence and success.
